excerpts: Title: Area Health Resources Files. Get information from over 50 data sources at county, state, national levels. AHRF is released annually by the Bureau of Health Workforce; latest data year per variable can differ. Dashboard: select AHRF Year, Health Profession Type (County Level File vs State Level File), Population Type, State; data as of 01/29/2026; year select shows 2024..2019. Documentation section links Methods and Definition (PDF) and download https://data.hrsa.gov/data/download?data=AHRF.
